claims.assertion: Mari says biological, humanlike Shadow People come from Mensa and exist three-quarters in the lower astral, one-quarter physical, causing their ghostlike appearance.
claims.speaker: Mari Swaruu
claims.qualifiers: Mari presents this as information from her group.

claims.assertion: Mari says the Federation classifies them as low-danger regressives outside its membership; they are interstellar and often invade less advanced cultures.
claims.speaker: Mari Swaruu

claims.assertion: Mari says they may be hostile or peaceful in homes; low or red light and infrared cameras can reveal them.
claims.speaker: Mari Swaruu
